items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: I met a German who was very interested... I know him.

ctx.x: A few, a few of them. But I met a German who was very interested. I can't remember his name, maybe it's Schulz.
Maybe. I can't remember. He was very interested in jazz. I know him. Oh, you know. Schulz, it's his name. Yes, he's a critic. He's on the radio now in Germany. Oh, yes. Oh, yes.
